hints.text: Opposites sit on different sides of $0$ but at the same distance from it. Think about where $7$ is on the number line.
$7$ is $7$ units to the right of $0$. Its opposite is $7$ units to the left of $0$, so change the sign.
The number $7$ units left of $0$ is $-7$, so the opposite of $7$ is $-7$.

explanation: The opposite of a number is the same distance from $0$ but on the other side.
$7$ is $7$ units to the right of $0$, so its opposite is $7$ units to the left.
That number is $-7$, so the opposite of $7$ is $-7$.
